_note: User-maintained calendar of SCHEDULED data releases the pipeline must never report as fact before they occur. Each release needs an ISO-8601 datetime WITH a timezone offset and one or more lowercase keywords used to match figure-bearing facts. Past entries are ignored automatically (harmless), so no pruning is needed; a MISSING upcoming entry silently drops protection for that release, so keep the near-term ones current. Timezone: US Eastern is -04:00 (EDT) through 2026-11-01 and -05:00 (EST) from 2026-11-01. FOMC policy statements release at 14:00 ET on the second day of each meeting; BLS releases (CPI/PPI/Employment Situation) are 08:30 ET. See freshness.py and orchestrator.py.
